units.name: School of Business
units.evidence: Official School of Business hosts the Logistics and Supply Chain Resilience academic program. No separately named logistics department is established, so the verified school is retained as host.

decisions.reason: Imported label corresponds to a program subject. Official current Logistics and Supply Chain Resilience program is represented by its School of Business host rather than invented as a department.
